sn12.40:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Yañca kho bhikkhave ceteti yañca pakappeti yañca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā || ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti || || Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nati hoti || natyā sati āgatigati hoti || āgatigatiyā sati cutūpapāto hoti || cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇam sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti || || Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.40:2.1: No ce bhikkhave ceteti no ca pakappeti atha ce anuseti ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā || ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti || || Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe {virūḷhe} nati hoti || natiyā sati āgatigati hoti || āgatigatiyā sati cutūpapāto hoti || cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti || || Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.40:3.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave no ce ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā || ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti || Tad appatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe nati na hoti || natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti || āgatigatiyā asati cutupapāto na hoti || cutūpapāte asati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇam soka paridevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti || || Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhukkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || Dasamaṃ || || Kaḷārakhattiyavaggo catuttho || ||
sn12.40:4.0: Tassuddānam || || Bhūtam idaṃ Kalārañca || Dve ca Ñāṇassa vatthūni || Avijjāpaccayā ca dve || Natumhā Cetanā tayo ti || ||
